title: Your First Weekend at United States Air Force Academy, Shared as Cards
description: A conservative Friday-through-Sunday sequence using public Academy destinations, with access and schedule checks kept explicit.

cards.entity_name: General Bradley and Zita Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.title: Start at the Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · outside the North Gate
cards.notes: Begin with the exhibits and visitor information, then use staff guidance to shape the rest of your on-base route.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission gateway for orientation and exhibits before entering the wider campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hosmer Visitor Center is outside the North Gate, requires no military ID or base access to enter, and is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: The General Bradley and Zita Hosmer Visitor Center
cards.access_notes: Official page lists daily 9 a.m.–5 p.m. hours and federal-holiday, Christmas Eve, and New Year’s Eve closures; free on-site parking.

cards.title: Take the Chapel Trail slowly
cards.subtitle: Friday · Hosmer Visitor Center to Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the paved third-mile trail for the approach to the cadet area; pause at benches and allow extra time at altitude.
cards.short_summary: A short paved route linking the visitor center with the chapel and Honor Court area.
cards.evidence_claim: Chapel Trail is a 1/3-mile paved nature trail from the Visitor Center to the Cadet Chapel, Honor Court, and cadet viewing area, with benches along the way.
cards.access_notes: The Academy advises visitors not acclimated to altitude to take breaks and drink water; limited-mobility visitors may need their own wheelchair and assistance.

cards.title: See the Cadet Chapel’s landmark form
cards.subtitle: Friday · base of Chapel Trail
cards.notes: View the 17-spire exterior from the designated route, and treat the current renovation enclosure as part of the site’s story.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s all-faith chapel is currently closed for its long-term renovation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cadet Chapel has 17 spires rising 150 feet and is closed for necessary repairs with an estimated completion in 2028.
cards.access_notes: Interior access is unavailable during the renovation; remain on public routes and observe construction controls.

cards.title: Walk through Honor Court
cards.subtitle: Friday · beside Harmon Hall
cards.notes: Continue from the trail into the open court and spend a few minutes identifying the memorials and historical sculptures.
cards.short_summary: An open cadet-area court with the Harmon memorial and multiple donated sculptures.
cards.evidence_claim: Honor Court is adjacent to Harmon Hall and contains the Harmon memorial plus historical statues and sculptures, including memorials to Tuskegee Airmen and Women Airforce Service Pilots.
cards.access_notes: Reach it by Chapel Trail or use the Planetarium parking area to bypass the trail; on-base access rules apply.

cards.title: If Friday aligns, watch Noon Meal Formation
cards.subtitle: Friday at 11:30 a.m. · Honor Court wall
cards.notes: Call the visitor center that morning, then watch from the Honor Court wall only if the weather-permitting formation is confirmed.
cards.short_summary: A documented Academy tradition: the Cadet Wing marches across the Terrazzo to lunch.
cards.evidence_claim: During the school year, the noon meal formation is scheduled Monday through Friday at 11:30 a.m.; guests may view it from the Honor Court wall, but it can be cancelled without notice.
cards.access_notes: Not a weekend activity: it is scheduled on school-year weekdays only. Call 719-333-2025 on the morning of a visit to confirm.

cards.title: Catch a free public Planetarium show
cards.subtitle: Friday, if a posted showtime fits · 2120 Cadet Drive
cards.notes: Check the Academy’s current schedule, arrive about ten minutes early, and join the first-come seating line without reservations.
cards.short_summary: A 110-seat, 360-degree digital venue offering free public shows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Planetarium offers free public shows open to all on a first-come, first-served basis, without tickets or reservations.
cards.access_notes: Consult the official weekly schedule before traveling; shows may change, and the Planetarium is closed on weekends, Graduation Day, and federal holidays.

cards.title: Reset at Arnold Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · west of the Cadet Area
cards.notes: Use the public social-center spaces to see the theater displays, then take a break before continuing to another outdoor stop.
cards.short_summary: A public-facing cadet social center with theater, food, coffee, meeting, and recreation spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Arnold Hall is the cadet wing’s social center and is open to the public except under base restrictions; it includes the theater, ballroom, food court, coffee shop, and recreational facilities.
cards.access_notes: Public entry is subject to base restrictions. Food and coffee are available but are optional purchases.

cards.title: Pause at Athletic Overlook
cards.subtitle: Friday drive · Academy Drive
cards.notes: Use this designated roadside overlook for a broad view of the athletic fields, then continue only on public roads and signed areas.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided-tour stop overlooking the Academy’s athletic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Athletic Overlook is the second overlook along Academy Drive and looks toward 57 athletic fields covering more than 140 acres.
cards.access_notes: A drive-up overlook on the official self-guided route; access remains subject to installation entry requirements.

cards.title: Walk the Heritage Trail at Doolittle Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday daytime · 3116 Academy Drive
cards.notes: Follow the Heritage Trail across Challenge Bridge and stop at the Southeast Asia Pavilion and Memorial Wall before heading out.
cards.short_summary: Association of Graduates headquarters with outdoor Vietnam-era memorial exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: Doolittle Hall is home to the Association of Graduates; its Heritage Trail includes Challenge Bridge, the Southeast Asia Pavilion, and Memorial Wall.
cards.access_notes: Official self-guided tour lists parking; the gift shop is open to the public Monday–Friday, 8 a.m.–4 p.m., but purchases are optional.

cards.title: Make Saturday a Falcon Spur Trail walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday daylight · near the North Gate B-52 display
cards.notes: Choose the short out-and-back route, stay on the established trail, and use the B-52 parking area and trail amenities as directed.
cards.short_summary: An easy 1.4-mile trail beginning near the North Gate B-52 static display.
cards.evidence_claim: Falcon Spur Trail is an easy 1.4-mile out-and-back route that begins near the North Gate B-52 display; the Academy lists parking there plus restrooms, trash cans, and picnic tables.
cards.access_notes: Use daylight and stay on the established path. The Academy requires dogs to be leashed and directs visitors to follow current base-entry instructions.

warnings: On-base destinations remain subject to Academy entry rules and operational restrictions. The Friday-only Noon Meal Formation and weekday Planetarium option are intentionally conditional rather than assumed weekend activities.
